question: Which Indian has won two Oscars in the same year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**AR Rahman.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A.R. Rahman is an Indian who won two Oscars in the year **2009**.
 
• He achieved this remarkable feat at the **81st Academy Awards for his work in the film Slumdog Millionaire.**
 
• Rahman won:
 
 
• Best Original Score for Slumdog Millionaire.
 
• Best Original Song for the song "Jai Ho" from the same movie.
